summary: zfill pads a string with ASCII zeroes to a minimum width.
documentation: zfill pads a string with ASCII zeroes to a minimum width. A leading plus or minus sign stays at the front, with padding inserted after it. Strings already wide enough are not shortened.
caution: The method does not validate the input as a number. It formats text, including an empty string.
scenarios: Display signed adjustment codes in a fixed-width report.
Align signed integer text without moving the sign.
title: Pad signed adjustment text
problem: Input is a string containing optional leading + or - and decimal digits, or an empty string. Return its zfill(5) form. Keep a sign at the beginning, preserve longer text and do not parse it as an integer.
goal: Use str.zfill() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use zfill so padding follows a leading sign.
